eng: DB InfraGO AG is Deutsche Bahn's public-service infrastructure company, formed on 1 January 2024 from DB Netz AG and DB Station&Service AG. It operates about 33,000 km of rail network and around 5,400 stations and employs about 68,000 people. In Hamburg it advertises jobs at Hammerbrookstraße 44, and Deutsche Bahn offers a dual study programme in surveying and geoinformatics there.
de: Die DB InfraGO AG ist die gemeinwohlorientierte Infrastrukturgesellschaft der Deutschen Bahn, entstanden am 1. Januar 2024 aus DB Netz AG und DB Station&Service AG. Sie betreibt rund 33.000 km Schienennetz und etwa 5.400 Bahnhöfe und beschäftigt rund 68.000 Mitarbeitende. In Hamburg schreibt sie Stellen am Standort Hammerbrookstraße 44 aus; die Deutsche Bahn bietet dort zudem ein duales Studium Vermessung und Geoinformatik an.
notes: Address Hammerbrookstraße 44, 20097 Hamburg is taken from a DB InfraGO job ad on jobijoba (Feinplaner LST). It is not confirmed on DB's own site, so confidence is medium. Size (68,000 employees) and HQ Frankfurt come from dbinfrago.com/web-en/profile. A search result shows a DB dual study programme in Vermessung und Geoinformatik in Hamburg (aubi-plus), but the page could not be fetched. No GIS product was named in any ad seen, so g_stack is null. No linkedin.com/company URL for DB InfraGO appeared in results; the profile page links only the showcase page linkedin.com/showcase/db-personenbahnhöfe (Stations division), which was not used. No kununu URL or careers URL was verified.

eng: Dr. Hesse und Partner Ingenieure (dhpi) is a Hamburg surveying and geodata engineering firm whose motto is 'Geodaten sind unser Geschäft – und das seit 1920'. It offers construction and architectural surveying, BIM, structural monitoring, UAV and mobile mapping, and industrial measurement such as laser tracking for shipbuilding and plant engineering. It works mainly with Leica instruments, 3D laser scanners and a Zoller+Fröhlich Profiler 9012 mobile mapping system.
de: Dr. Hesse und Partner Ingenieure (dhpi) ist ein Hamburger Ingenieurbüro für Vermessung und Geodaten – 'Geodaten sind unser Geschäft – und das seit 1920'. Das Leistungsspektrum umfasst Bau- und Architekturvermessung, BIM, Bauwerksmonitoring, UAV und Mobile Mapping sowie Industrievermessung wie Lasertracking für Schiffbau und Anlagenbau. Eingesetzt werden vor allem Leica-Instrumente, 3D-Laserscanner und ein Zoller+Fröhlich Profiler 9012.
notes: Address confirmed on dhpi.com and on its join.com company page (Blohmstraße 29, 21079 Hamburg). Size 11-50 and the LinkedIn URL come from join.com/companies/dhpi. Careers page is dhpi.com/de/karriere. Its two current ads (Projektingenieur Bauwerksmonitoring, Vermessungstechniker Außendienst) are in German. Neither the ads nor the website names any software, only Leica instruments and a Z+F Profiler 9012 with MapCam (hardware), so g_stack stays null. No kununu page was found.

eng: AllTerra Deutschland GmbH is a Trimble partner of more than 30 years that sells and supports surveying and construction technology: total stations, GNSS, 3D laser scanners, mobile mapping, monitoring and software such as Trimble Business Center and Trimble Access. It is headquartered in Raunheim, has 13 German locations including Hamburg (Tempowerkring 1a), and belongs to the MEB Group, which has over 250 employees.
de: Die AllTerra Deutschland GmbH ist seit über 30 Jahren Trimble-Partner und bietet Vertrieb, Schulung und Support für Vermessungs- und Bautechnik: Tachymeter, GNSS, 3D-Laserscanner, Mobile Mapping, Monitoring und Software wie Trimble Business Center und Trimble Access. Sitz ist Raunheim; mit 13 Standorten in Deutschland, darunter Hamburg (Tempowerkring 1a), gehört sie zur MEB Group mit über 250 Mitarbeitenden.
notes: Hamburg address confirmed on allterra.de/kontakt (Tempowerkring 1a, 21079; headquarters Am Prime-Parc 11, 65479 Raunheim). The g_stack is Trimble software from the product range on allterra.de; it is what the company sells and supports, since the job ads name no specific software. The size 201-500 rests on the MEB Group figure of over 250 employees (careers page), not a figure for AllTerra alone. Careers page lists a Support Mitarbeiter Vermessungslösungen role that includes Hamburg; ads are in German. No LinkedIn company URL or kununu page appeared in two searches, and the site shows no social links.
